SELECT op.*,audi.businessType,audi.riskSource,audi.suditProcess FROM TBL_NBSJ_OPERATE op LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_AUTHORIZATION auth ON op. AUTHID = auth. AUTHID LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_AUDITPROGRAM audi ON audi.programid = auth.programid LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_TARGETTYPE target ON target.targetId = audi.targetId LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_TEAMSTAFF team on team.id = auth.TEAMSTAFFID
1=1
AND target.targetId = #{tblNbsjOperateVo.targetId}
and finish != 1
and audi.businessType like concat(concat('%',#{tblNbsjOperateVo.businessType}),'%')
and auth.projectid = #{tblNbsjOperateVo.projectId} and team.staffid = #{tblNbsjOperateVo.staffid} order by op.OPERATEID DESC
